summary: Completed backend API regression and live desktop/mobile UI testing. Backend endpoints and production builds passed; core desktop navigation, upload, quiz, citations, and overflow checks passed. Found mobile navigation inaccessible, source upload persistence not reflected by list APIs, and tutor response UX lacks loading feedback.

critical.issue: A valid PDF upload returns 200 and is inserted into MongoDB, but subsequent GET /api/sources still returns only the original three hardcoded sources; the uploaded source is not surfaced to the frontend.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px the sidebar is display:none and no mobile menu/navigation replacement exists, leaving users unable to reach Course sources, Ask Lumina, Assessments, Mastery map, or Evaluation.
The interactive file input has no unique data-testid (only its label does), violating the testability requirement.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/chat succeeds but takes about 9.6 seconds in a direct live request; the UI has no submitting/loading indicator, so the user sees no progress while waiting. The 12-second browser check did not observe the assistant response consistently.
Upload success toast closes the modal but does not refresh dashboard/source state, and the backend list does not include the newly uploaded source.

action_items: Make /api/sources and /api/dashboard read persisted source records (or merge uploaded records) and refresh frontend data after upload.
Add a mobile menu/drawer so all workspace views remain reachable on small screens.
Add tutor submitting state/indicator and preserve clear error feedback during the slow LLM request.
Add a unique data-testid to the file input and ensure tutor evidence renders returned citation data rather than a hardcoded Slide 12 label.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard, sources, and mastery data are hardcoded module-level arrays while uploads are stored in MongoDB, creating a broken persistence boundary.
Quiz submit returns updated mastery but does not persist it, so per-topic mastery tracking is not durable.
The frontend catch/fallback path for tutor requests has no loading state and the citation presentation ignores the API's citation values.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (desktop core flows pass; mobile navigation and tutor wait-state findings)

seed_data_creation: One browser PDF upload (browser-check.pdf) was sent through the real object-storage integration; it returned 200 but was not exposed by subsequent /api/sources. No mocked APIs were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop dashboard/navigation, real upload, quiz submission, evaluation, mastery rendering, build, py_compile, and API regression are covered. Retest mobile navigation, source list persistence after upload, tutor loading/response, dynamic citations, and durable mastery updates.
rca of the issue: The source upload handler writes a MongoDB document, but dashboard/sources handlers return the static SOURCES constant, so the write is disconnected from reads. Mobile CSS hides the only nav element at max-width 650px without rendering the imported Menu control. Tutor awaits a slow external LLM call without any loading state; browser timing can make the flow appear idle even though the API eventually returns 200.
